# Zero-slot yearly kernel hook (called from oe_gk_yearly_dispatch once per year globally).
oe_sea2_kernel_yearly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_sea2_ran_y ?= current_year } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_sea2_ran_y value = current_year }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:DAI
				c:DAI = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			c:DAI = { oe_sea2_dai_tick = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:AYU

		}

				country_exists = c:SUK

						is_ai = no

						is_ai = no

# Country scope: fires at most one oe_sea2 historical event per yearly tick.
oe_sea2_dai_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_sea2_ev1_done }
			current_year >= 1345
			owns = location:thang_long
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_sea2_ev1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sea2.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_sea2_ev2_done }
			current_year >= 1418
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_sea2_ev2_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sea2.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_sea2_ev3_done }
			current_year >= 1460
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_sea2_ev3_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sea2.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_sea2_ev4_done }

		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_sea2_ev4_done value = 1 }
